statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ trades 29,409.75, +0.52%, roughly 67 points below the 29,477.00 session high, after the previous assessment hour printed 29,448.50 within 30 points of that high. The overnight up-leg has stopped extending and has begun to retrace, which is the change that moves Tail out of the watch band to 19. The 29,247.75 Globex reopen low is still untested for a fourth consecutive hour, so the larger up structure is intact and the reading eases by one point rather than collapsing. The amplifier stack remains unaligned: the 10-year sits at 5.01 percent but is flat overnight, VIX closed at 17.71, WTI near 102 dollars is falling for a second session on the reported Saudi pipeline repair timeline, and the latest-session megacap tape was mixed at five advancers of eight with a mean change of -0.11 percent while semiconductors were firmer. Stress remains high at 69 on the rates and geopolitical backdrop rather than on index structure.
recommendation: The distinction this hour is between a persistent up-leg and an extending one. Persistence is still present, since the 29,247.75 reopen low has survived four hours untested, but extension has reversed: the index added roughly 14 points last hour and has since given back about 39, leaving it 67 points under the session high. A retracement of that size is the behaviour a mean-reversion basket needs and the condition the calibration treats as grounds for the reading to fall after an event has printed. Against that, the rates picture has not improved. The 10-year at 5.01 percent is the highest since 2007, the 2-year near 4.73 percent is at its highest since 2024, and Goldman Sachs has moved its next-hike call to October, so the environment stays difficult even as the immediate path risk eases. Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with Tail well below the block threshold. The narrow danger window is retained at 12:30 to 14:30 UTC, spanning the bundled US release block and the cash open, which is the first genuine test of the post-hike tape.
headline: NQ fades to 29,409.75, about 67 points off the session high, as the overnight leg stops extending and retraces; Tail eases to 19 while Stress holds at 69 on a 5.01 percent ten-year
body:
The FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3-3/4 to 4 percent at 18:00 UTC on 16 September in a unanimous 12-0 vote, the first increase in three years, stating that inflation remains elevated and that the action supports a timelier return to the 2 percent goal. Chair Warsh used the press conference to say inflation is too high and has been for too long, and projections point to at least one further increase in 2026. Goldman Sachs has since moved its next-hike expectation to the October meeting, published at 21:26 US Eastern on 16 September.

Cash markets closed split on 16 September. The Nasdaq-100 finished at 28,945.06, up 0.02 percent, after a 28,753.29 to 29,235.89 range, while the Dow fell about 1.2 percent and the S&P 500 about 0.4 percent. The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.01 percent against a 4.94 to 5.01 percent day range, the highest since 2007; the H.15 release for 15 September shows the 2-year at 4.67 percent and the 10-year at 5.00 percent, and the 2-year is currently quoted near 4.73 percent, its highest since 2024. VIX closed at 17.71, up 2.97 percent, after a 16.40 to 18.94 range.

Since the Globex reopen, NQ has traded a 29,247.75 to 29,477.00 range and is quoted at 29,409.75, up 0.52 percent, as of 02:15 UTC. The reopen low has not been tested for four consecutive assessment hours, but the leg has stopped extending: the previous hour printed 29,448.50 within 30 points of the high, and price has since given back about 39 points to sit roughly 67 points below it. That is an observed retracement rather than the shallow-pullback structure that held the previous reading in the watch band.

Cross-asset evidence is not aligned. WTI is near 102 dollars after a 3.2 percent drop to a 102.43 close, extending a second session of losses as the United States said the damaged Saudi East-West pipeline will restart within days, with Saudi Arabia seeking to restore about half of the 7 million barrel per day link quickly and full capability in roughly six weeks. That unwinds part of a supply premium built during a month in which crude rallied more than 16 percent on Persian Gulf escalation. Shared latest-session context shows megacaps mixed at five advancers of eight with a mean change of -0.11 percent, semiconductors firmer at a mean of +0.82 percent, and sector breadth split with technology marginally positive against weaker communication services, consumer cyclicals and software. Asian cash trade was two-way, with the Nikkei 225 up 0.87 percent and the Kospi up 1 percent against a 0.49 percent fall in the Hang Seng.

The scheduled path ahead is the 12:30 UTC block of initial jobless claims, housing starts, building permits and the Philadelphia Fed manufacturing index, the first labour and activity read priced against the new policy path, followed by the 13:30 UTC cash open. The danger window is held narrow at 12:30 to 14:30 UTC for that reason. Shared Finviz context was partial this hour, with the futures and calendar sections unavailable, so cross-asset futures alignment could not be read from it and the assessment relies on independently verified quotes; breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections were available and are treated as delayed latest-session context, not live price-path evidence.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding Claude clock-hours are available from published history and none has been restated with later information. The cycle opened in the low band at 14 to 16 with a normal dominant mode through the Asian and European sessions of 16 September, with no observed directional structure. It entered the watch band at 12:00 UTC with the US pre-market and held 20 to 22 through the early afternoon, reaching 24 in the 18:00 UTC statement hour. The single orange print came at 19:00 UTC, Tail 31 with a trend-down mode, during the press conference and the yield extension through 5 percent. It fell back to 20 within an hour and to 18 and 16 by 21:00 and 22:00 UTC as the post-event path proved orderly and retracements resumed, which is the pattern the calibration expects after price discovery completes. The last three hours ran 18, 20 and 20 with a trend-up mode as the overnight leg built, holding the watch band on the untested reopen low rather than on any fresh amplifier. Stress stayed in the high band throughout, between 70 and 79, never dropping to the elevated band, which reflects the rates and geopolitical backdrop rather than index path behaviour.
outlookSummary: The forecast opens at 19 for the current hour, the only slot backed by observed price-path structure, then eases to an 18 plateau through the thin late-Asian and pre-European hours as the leg ages out of its most efficient window. It firms to 19 from the European cash open onward, where continental desks price the hike and a 5.01 percent ten-year for the first time, and holds there through the European morning. The 12:00 to 14:00 UTC slots carry the highest conditional readings at 21, 23 and 22, spanning the bundled 12:30 UTC release block and the 13:30 UTC cash open, and they are conditional event readings rather than assertions that post-release continuation has been observed. From 15:00 UTC the path steps back to 20 and then 19 through the US afternoon on the usual midday liquidity decline, with a single 20 at 19:00 UTC for the power hour into the cash close. The final six slots decline through 18 and 17 into the quietest part of the cycle and the next Asian reopen. Stress traces the same shape from 69 now to a 67 overnight trough, 76 at the cash open and 65 at the horizon edge. Confidence decays from 86 to 63 purely with forecast horizon, since no live price path exists beyond the current hour.
